lines: 论到全能者，我们不能测度；
他大有能力，有公平和大义，
必不苦待人。
論到全能者，我們不能測度；
他大有能力，有公平和大義，
必不苦待人。
Touching the Almighty
we cannot find him out : he is excellent in power
and in judgment
and in plenty of justice : he will not afflict .

we cannot find him out : he is excellent in power
and in judgment
and in plenty of justice : he will not afflict .
We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness
he will not oppress.
There is no searching out of the Ruler of all: his strength and his judging are great; he is full of righteousness
doing no wrong.

“I know that you can do all things
and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.
I see that you are able to do every thing
and to give effect to all your designs.

并且耶和华赐给他的比他从前所有的加倍。

And the LORD turned the captivity of Job
when he prayed for his friends : also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.

The LORD restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. The LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.
And the Lord made up to Job for all his losses
after he had made prayer for his friends: and all Job had before was increased by the Lord twice as much.

nor stand on the path of sinners
nor sit in the seat of scoffers;
Happy is the man who does not go in the company of sinners
or take his place in the way of evil-doers
or in the seat of those who do not give honour to the Lord.

that produces its fruit in its season
whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.
He will be like a tree planted by the rivers of water
which gives its fruit at the right time
whose leaves will ever be green; and he will do well in all his undertakings.
因为耶和华知道义人的道路；

For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous : but the way of the ungodly shall perish .

but the end of the sinner is destruction.
